---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load-noaa}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

data("ny_noaa")

```

```{r clean-noaa}
noaa_clean = ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10
  ) |>
  filter(
    year >= 2000,
    year <= 2010
  )


```
```{r monthly-summary}
weather_monthly = noaa_clean |>
  group_by(year, month) |>
  summarize(
    avg_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_tmin = mean(tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(avg_tmax),
    !is.na(avg_tmin),
    is.finite(avg_tmax),
    is.finite(avg_tmin)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month_date = as.Date(
      sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year, month)
    )
  )


```
##

### Monthly Average Maximum Temperature

```{r line-plot}
line_plot = weather_monthly |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month_date, y = avg_tmax)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Average Maximum Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(line_plot)
```
##

### Average Maximum Temperature by Month

```{r bar-plot}
monthly_summary = weather_monthly |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    avg_temperature = mean(avg_tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month_name = factor(
      month.abb[month],
      levels = month.abb
    )
  )

bar_plot = monthly_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month_name, y = avg_temperature)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Average Maximum Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(bar_plot)
```
##

### Maximum vs Minimum Temperature

```{r scatter-plot}
scatter_plot = weather_monthly |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = avg_tmin,
      y = avg_tmax,
      color = factor(year)
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Average Minimum Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Average Maximum Temperature (°C)",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(scatter_plot)
```
